title: Craft Bells!
description: YOU CAN FINALLY CRAFT BELLS! (There is also a secret.)(By Nekky9180)
body:
# CRAFT BELLS! ### You know how Mojang never made a recipie for the Bell? ### Well here's a datapack that adds one! ![recepie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4fa2cc00a178b28d7b6b55a625c669587708c866.png) ### The block in the middle is any wood plank if you didn't know. Its what MCreator textures Any Wood Plank. Secret: Let a zombie hit you.
What happens:
Spoiler A advancement pops up saying Get hit by a zombie and a lot of the "Challenge complete" music plays, overlapping each other.
Made with [MCreator](https://mcreator.net/)
